invariants.rationale: Returned region name is always non-empty as 'name' is never truncated to empty and always at least retains original, which must have content.
Method does not allow for 'name' to be null as passed parameter and JDK String.contains/lastIndexOf require non-null.
If 'atlas_imagelayer' is found and we extract after '/', result will never contain '/', else result is always name which may already not contain '/'.
When 'atlas_imagelayer' and there is a '/', result is the substring after that slash.
